items.title: Verizon Communications (VZ) Lands Thames Freeport 5G Role As Takeover Talk Returns
items.summary: Verizon Communications (NYSE:VZ) has been selected to deploy a major private 5G platform at Thames Freeport in Europe. The Thames Freeport project is described as one of Europe's largest private 5G networks for logistics and manufacturing operations.
